WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM film f
  LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT AVG(rc.rental_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(rc.rental_count - oa.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM rating_counts rc
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE rc.rental_count > oa.avg_count
